omar: Hey folks — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/16888 is blocked. CI matrix failing intermittently on macOS-snap-7 and linux-shard-3 with the visual snapshot test. Error excerpt below.

omar: ```
Diff found: tests/ui/golden/render_button.test.png
Found: 2px offset on icon layer
Command: bazel test //ui:render_button --test_output=errors
```

gina: looking ... i'm out for another 30m, can someone kick a targeted rerun for shard-3? :eyes:

alex: i can do targeted rerun. gimme a sec to spawn a job.

buildkite: buildkite: Requeued job 9876 (pr-16888) by alex — targeted: linux-shard-3

alex: rerun started. if it passes we still need an approver for the snapshot update

jessica: fyi this looks like the nondet rendering we saw last week. try `CI_ENABLE_PIXEL_STABLE=1` local repro, but it's flaky in headless chromium

omar: thanks. repro attempt with that env failed locally (still diff). If rerun passes in CI i can open the snapshot update, but i don't want to land a noisy golden.

sam: i'm +1 to hold off snapshot update until we confirm repro. also please add `//test:flake_quarantine` tag if we want an immediate merge with quarantine bypass.

gina: alex — any luck? :pray:

alex: rerun passed on shard-3, macOS still failing on shard-7. logs show intermittent pixel shift at 0.8s. attaching tail:

alex: ```
AssertionError: images not equal
  expected hash: ab12ff...
  actual hash:   ab10ff...
  diff bbox: x=12..18 y=4..10
```

omar: ok. plan: i'll open a snapshot PR with the updated golden but mark it as draft and add `quarantine:flaky-ui-16888` label. Requesting a second set of eyes from @jessica or @gina before un-draft. Also, if we want immediate merge we can ask eng-oncall to approve quarantine bypass.

jessica: sg. i'll take a look in ~1h. if it's a true change we should update golden, otherwise we add a repro/skip and follow-up.

buildkite: buildkite: Job 9876 finished: 1 passed, 1 failed — overall: unstable

omar: noted. i'll leave as draft for now. thanks all.
